This collaborative project by **Brody Duncan**, **Nathan Jones**, and **Tyran Heaton** explores Spotify music data through a Python package and a Streamlit app. The project focuses on cleaning a large song dataset, analyzing audio-feature patterns, and building similarity-based recommendations.
